cls: gas-free dSphs with a resolved CMD SFH and stellar sigma, in no sample used by the record (CFG42, CFG874, CFG880/LVD-83, CFG933, CFG936)
quantity: Delta E = <ln(sigma_obs/sigma_law)>_Lm - <...>_Q at matched M_V and r_h; sigma_law CFG880 (Ups_V 2, nu_e)
kill_line: with >= 5 per group matched within 0.5 mag and 0.15 dex in r_h: excluded on a footing if the observed Delta E lies outside [min - 2 se, max + 2 se] of the (S) prediction (sealed function at the sample's own M_V, r_h, SFHs; the template table when only the split is known)
settings: kappa = 1/2 FITTED; footings never pooled; cold energy, not a particle; not theory closed
